_meta.comment: Status: designed, never served (ADR-0039 d2). The designed annex of the MCP catalog: the tools and the served tools' arguments that mcp-plugin.md decides and the server does not serve. tools/list never serves this file; mcp-tools.json holds exactly the served catalog, and the two name no tool in common (scripts/check_contract_sync.py). An entry moves to mcp-tools.json in the change that serves it. A designed tool called by name is a JSON-RPC -32602 naming this file; a designed argument sent to a served tool is refused with request.validation: oml_read names lineage and depth in details.field, and oml_write refuses attachments, simulation_id and simulated_time as outside its input schema. A fourth served tool needs a record saying why no parameter of the three, no resource and no hook carries it (ADR-0039 d8).

tools.name: oml_relate_propose
tools.description: Propose a labelled edge - claim-to-claim or workarea-to-workarea. The proposal is journalled and pending; it confers nothing and changes no access until a different dreamer ratifies it (R2 extends to edges). Ratification is not on this surface. Rides the designed POST /v2/edges with kind claim or workarea (ADR-0039 d9).

kind.description: Which graph the edge lives in; endpoints are workareas, by node id or name, or artifact ids accordingly.

label.description: For workarea edges, the closed set: relates_to | continues | derived_from | mirrors. The claim-edge label vocabulary is not fixed by the design - an open detail tracked in the roadmap.

from.description: The from endpoint (a workarea's node id or name, or an artifact id, per kind).

to.description: The to endpoint (a workarea's node id or name, or an artifact id, per kind).

note.description: Optional proposer note, journalled with the proposal.

tools.name: oml_vocab
tools.description: Read the tenant's vocabularies: term lookup, deterministic typeahead, hierarchy over the per-release closure, and SSSOM-shaped mappings. One tool, four actions, each one GET /v2/vocab/* call. Strictly read-only at the reader ceiling: proposing a term or mapping is oml_write with the matching kind, and nothing here deprecates, ratifies or cuts a release.

action.description: suggest takes q (and optionally workarea); get and hierarchy take curie; mappings takes term.

q.description: With action suggest: the prefix+label typeahead text, deterministic matching only - no model runs here.

workarea.description: With action suggest: optionally restrict to one granted vocabulary workarea, by node id or name.

curie.description: With action get or hierarchy: the term's CURIE. Unknown and out-of-scope are indistinguishable (fail closed).

direction.description: With action hierarchy: which way to look over ratified is_a, served from the per-release closure (a lookup, never a traversal).

release.description: With action hierarchy: optional release id; defaults to the owning vocabulary's latest ratified release.

term.description: With action mappings: the CURIE whose ratified mappings to return.

limit.description: Page size, where the action paginates (suggest, hierarchy, mappings).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

lineage.description: Get mode, with artifact_id: return the claim's declared lineage in that direction as claim items, the successor of oml_graph (ADR-0039 d2, d4). Served once the lineage read is routed.

depth.description: With lineage: how many hops from artifact_id; a value above the served ceiling is a typed limit error, never a truncated answer pretending to be whole.

upload_session.description: A completed upload session; its recorded digest is bound into the signed submission envelope (D3).

attachments.description: Upload sessions completed through the designed oml attach put <file> or an SDK's upload. MCP carries no file bytes, so no tool uploads (ADR-0039 d2).

simulation_id.description: Optional simulation channel id, passed through to POST /v1/memories, in submit and supersede mode alike. Required when the target or derives_from touches a simulation row (submission.simulation_id_required otherwise); writing with it requires the calling key to be in that simulation's journalled audience (simulation.audience_refused). The successor of the v0.3.0 oml_remember, oml_learn and oml_supersede argument (ADR-0039 d9, d10).

simulated_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp, passed through with simulation_id. Declared data, never backdating - the journal keeps the real timestamp.
